description: This file defines API functions for interacting with a document store backend, including CRUD operations, vector store management, and component retrieval.

methods.name: getAllDocumentStores
methods.description: Fetches all document stores with optional parameters.

methods.name: getSpecificDocumentStore
methods.description: Retrieves a specific document store by ID.

methods.name: createDocumentStore
methods.description: Creates a new document store with provided data.

methods.name: deleteLoaderFromStore
methods.description: Deletes a loader from a store by ID and file ID.

methods.name: getFileChunks
methods.description: Retrieves chunks of a file within a store.

methods.name: updateDocumentStore
methods.description: Updates an existing document store.

methods.name: previewChunks
methods.description: Previews file chunks based on provided body.

methods.name: processLoader
methods.description: Processes a loader with given body and loader ID.

methods.name: getDocumentLoaders
methods.description: Retrieves available document loaders.

methods.name: deleteChunkFromStore
methods.description: Deletes a specific chunk from a store.

methods.name: editChunkFromStore
methods.description: Edits a specific chunk in a store.

methods.name: deleteDocumentStore
methods.description: Deletes a document store.

methods.name: insertIntoVectorStore
methods.description: Inserts data into a vector store.

methods.name: getVectorStoreProviders
methods.description: Retrieves vector store component providers.

methods.name: getEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Retrieves embedding component providers.

methods.name: getRecordManagerProviders
methods.description: Retrieves record manager component providers.

methods.name: saveVectorStoreConfig
methods.description: Saves configuration for a vector store.

methods.name: queryVectorStore
methods.description: Queries data from a vector store.

methods.name: deleteVectorStoreDataFromStore
methods.description: Deletes data from a vector store, optionally by document ID.

methods.name: updateVectorStoreConfig
methods.description: Updates vector store configuration.

methods.name: saveProcessingLoader
methods.description: Saves a processed loader.

methods.name: refreshLoader
methods.description: Refreshes a loader by store ID.

methods.name: generateDocStoreToolDesc
methods.description: Generates a tool description for a document store.

methods.name: getDocumentStoreConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific document store.
